description: This Java class 'ModelFormFieldBuilder' is a builder for constructing 'ModelFormField' objects, which represent form fields in a web application framework. It includes methods for initializing from XML, merging overrides, inducing field info from entity or service models, and managing various form field properties.

classes.name: ModelFormFieldBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing ModelFormField objects with various properties and methods to initialize from XML, merge overrides, and induce field info from entity or service models.

methods.name: ModelFormFieldBuilder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the builder from an XML Element, ModelForm, ModelReader, and DispatchContext.

methods.description: Copy constructor from an existing ModelFormField.

methods.description: Adds an UpdateArea to the onClickUpdateAreas list.

methods.description: Builds and returns a ModelFormField object from the current builder state.
